newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers edge lower as demand remains thin.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers edge lower as demand remains thin.

text.p: ARA bunkers were slightly weaker on Friday with lack of demand and good product supplies nudging prices lower, brokers said
Rotterdam 380 CST was lower at $100/$101 FOB against $102/$10 seen in afternoon trade on Wednesday.
"There's still a lot of product around," said one broker. "Added to this is the fact shipowners appear to be holding back in the hope prices might go lower."
"Perhaps they've been picking up material in Singapore or the States," said another broker. "ARA prices were higher than elsewhere before the slump."
Mediterranean prices were relatively stable although trade was relatively thin, said local brokers.
In Italy, Augusta 380 CST was quoted at $115/$117 a tonne and in Spain, Algeciras 380 CST was put at $116/$118, both unchanged from Thursday.
